- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx`, the discard handler (`engine.edit.discardDraftConfirm` near `:1928` and `engine.edit.draftDiscarded` near `:1957` at `main` `6e4f144`): both name the item by the label the page already shows, falling back to the machine `type/name` only when the item has no label;
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, those two strings in every locale the file carries (`:271`–`:272` en, `:3818`–`:3819` zh);
- the objectui#12303 pin (`ResourceEditPage.discardFeedback-12303.test.tsx`), which asserts the old string, updated with the fix, and a new test beside it;
- one `.changeset/12690-*.md` for `@object-ui/app-shell`.

Outside the surface: the other `engine.edit.*` strings, the discard request itself, and `packages/i18n`'s language packs.

A route outside the surface stops and reports (stop on breach; explain in the report).
Container & model: `S`, `mode:cloud`, `model: opus` (default tier; no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no
Clause-② reason: two strings in the metadata editor's module-local dictionary change wording and placeholders. No prop, export or `packages/i18n` key changes. If the dev finds that dictionary is exported, line 2 becomes `Clause-②: yes` and the body says so.
Responsibility: the Setup metadata editor (`@object-ui/app-shell` `ResourceEditPage`) | objectui#12303 added the discard feedback and pinned its wording | every admin who discards a draft of a labelled item
Thread-read: 6218468839
Serial constraints cleared: read at objectui `main` `6e4f144`. No open PR names `ResourceEditPage.tsx` or `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` (every open PR's file list was read). The last change to `ResourceEditPage.tsx` is PR #12745 (objectui#12680, merged). This seat's in-flight objectui#12780 (PR #12818) is in `flow-node-config.ts` and shares no file.

- The file surface and `Clause-②: no` are unchanged.

The claim `6226200185` is amended here:** its file surface now also covers `packages/app-shell/src/views/RuntimeDraftBar.tsx` (the one `discardDraftConfirm` call) and `RuntimeDraftBar.test.tsx`. A second key for the same sentence would only drift.
- **Open question 2 (which label): A, the draft's label.** The confirm names what is being discarded in the words on screen.
- **Open question 3:** noted. The seat's claim correction `6226264912` already says so; PR #12818 is still in flight and the hunks are far apart.
- **The finding** (the edit page's breadcrumb shows the machine name) is recorded, not filed: polish-class and unreproduced as a defect.
- **The seat read the diff** at `18916e8`: 7 files, +266/−12. `doDiscardDraft` reads `draft.label` once before the DELETE and falls back to `type/name`; both dictionary strings take one `{item}` in en and zh; the #12303 pin is updated, not deleted. `Clause-②: no` stands: the dictionary is not exported.
